items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 played this last year, but then stopped
items.summary: played this last year, but then stopped cause i can't focus on it while doing some other real life things. now i'm free and know better how to manage the time and habit, i can finally enjoy the beautiful graphic and game mechanic i used to love! and i'm glad to the dev for not letting the fandom down, we trully appreciate the eager and enthusasm on keeping this game alive! 🥰
items.author: SuryaD
